user_interface: Research checks, not new marks or formal score

nar.missing_previous_corner: NO FLAG, NEVER substitute previous finishing position
nar.goal: Find otherwise overlooked contenders and compare to ability baseline
nar.evidence: Nov 7-8: 17 horses/6 wins; Oct 17-18: 22 horses/1 win (hypothesis unstable)
nar.production: No ability changes, no additional purchases, no recommendation

jra.review: Pure ability ranks 2-5, training A/B, verified rest_days<70, and course_rank<=3 OR distance_rank<=3
jra.warning: 70+ day rest with training C/D is a strong caution, not an automatic exclusion
jra.research_three: Retain pure ability rank #1, prefer two qualifying horses among ranks 2-5 by pure ability order; fill remaining places by pure ability rank. Missing #1 means no picks
jra.missing_ability: Never extrapolate. Mark unavailable, including jump races
jra.production: No formal scores or betting purchases changed

pace.observed_missing: Do not treat default H as observed pace; show 未取得 unless provider value grounded
pace.predicted_pace: Keep a separate source/type from observed lap measurement

validation.policy: No use of Nov 7-8 in prospective metrics. Retain archived predictions made before post time. Require matching race IDs
validation.decision: Only propose changing a formal predictor after a meaningful out-of-sample improvement, never automatically merge
